# Sound Menu - Unified location for sound control
The Sound Menu provides a unified central location for a user to interact with the sound system from the panel. Adheres to the Atayana Indicator library spec.

## Features
 - Centralized sound management
 - Aids user experience while using the Atayana Indicators stack
